summary: Frontend-only smoke test of the PianoUnico 'always-visible days' fix at 390x844 (mobile) and 1920x1080 (desktop). All P0 checks pass: the 7 day tabs (piano-day-tab-lun ... piano-day-tab-dom) are rendered immediately when opening Piano Settimanale, even after deleting all batches. The save guard shows the info toast 'Nothing to save: add products to the days.' when clicking piano-save with 0 batches; adding a batch via piano-day-add-lun + piano-batch-product-lun-0 then piano-save produces the piano-saved-badge with 'Weekly plan saved (1 batches). It stays after refresh.'. No horizontal overflow at 390px (document.scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390) and piano-cal-row-lun-0 stays within viewport (right=327px). Note: because there was already a saved plan in archive (savedInfo!=null), the block-3 title reads 'Weekly plan ready · generated by Sitor' as per spec; the 'La tua settimana · tocca un giorno e componi il lavoro' fallback title triggers only when neither chosenLabel nor savedInfo is set (verified in code, PianoUnico.jsx L580-584). Regression P1 for full AI-generate flow not executed (Sitor slow, marked optional).
critical_code_review_comments: PianoUnico.jsx: title fallback correctly uses (chosenLabel || savedInfo) ternary. Once a plan has been saved, deleting all batches manually still shows 'ready' title until page is refreshed with empty archive — acceptable per spec but consider clearing savedInfo when totalBatches==0 for consistent UX.
piano-print button is always visible even before any content is generated (unlike piano-speak which is correctly conditional on options.length>0). Minor: consider gating print on totalBatches>0 too.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Piano Settimanale 'always-visible days' fix verified at 390px and 1920px. Login flow: dismiss cookie OK -> public-enter-capo -> admin-key digits for 198505 -> capo-gate-login click opens auth modal -> fill email/password -> button:has-text('Sign in') -> navigate via capo-secnav-piano. Full AI-generate P1 skipped due to expected slow LLM.
rca of the issue: Original bug: state 'week' initialised to null caused day tabs to render only after AI generation. Fix: initialise via EMPTY_WEEK() factory (line 269) so the AnimatePresence block at L570 always renders. Save guard added at L401-407 prevents saving 0-batch plans. Title fallback at L582-584 shows the 'compose the work' string when no plan exists. All fixes verified live.
